Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The road-test note says examiners use discretion when assistance technology reacts first; no scoring rule beyond that discretion is asserted [A03].
The autonomous-vehicle page points to two web addresses for more information; the addresses were not copied and no level-by-level detail beyond the page text is taught [A05].
Feature behavior is described as the handbook states it in general terms; individual vehicles may differ, which the handbook itself acknowledges by pointing to the owner's manual.
